label: TP
reason: At least one alert is confirmed as TP. The SQL injection alert (java/sql-injection) shows user-provided data reaching a database query sink without any mitigation. The XSS alert (java/xss) also shows a user-provided value reaching an HTML output sink, though it is partially mitigated by encodeForHTML, but the SQL injection is clearly exploitable.

evidence.note: SQL injection sink: 'new ..[] { .. }' with user-provided value from getHeader()
XSS sink: '... + ...' with user-provided value from getHeader(), partially mitigated by encodeForHTML but still vulnerable in context
